title: HorneroOS greeter clip source manifest
description: Source-side metadata for one greeter video clip. These manifests are NOT runtime files: they document provenance and licensing so the clip can be re-fetched, verified, and transcoded at image build time. Runtime files must never contain network URLs (see CONTRIBUTING_MEDIA.md).

id.description: Stable clip id, prefixed with ar-.

provider.description: Source provider identity, separate from license. Absent means wikimedia-commons (all pre-existing manifests).

page.description: Provider file/video page inspected for license: a Wikimedia Commons File: page, or a Pexels video page.

file.description: Original filename on Commons, or for Pexels the pinned rendition filename recorded at approval time (never an invented download URL).

short.description: Representable licenses. CC values are the Commons ship policy; 'Pexels' is the Pexels License (not a CC license) and may ship only with recorded distribution approval (see review.distribution).

status.description: Only own-work, reviewed, or written-permission may ship in media/manifests/. Anything else lives in media/candidates/.

distribution.description: Explicit distribution-approval state for binary-package redistribution. Absent on legacy Commons CC manifests, where a shippable review status is the recorded approval. Any provider/license without approval fails closed: not shippable, never packaged.

sha256.description: SHA256 of the original file as downloaded from the provider. Null only in media/candidates/ for files not yet fetched; must be filled before promotion to media/manifests/.
